verdict.rationale: Sardine ships AI agents for AML and sanctions alert review, so the question of whether those agents can use external MCP servers' tools is a fair one for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions connecting or plugging in MCP servers, or any MCP client capability. The agentic-ops claims and the llms.txt probe describe other features and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
